title: quarrystone/cli
text:
quarrystone/cli - the command line interface for the Quarrystone platform.

Maintained by runa-okonkwo, who reviews most of the pull requests that land here and writes the release notes by hand.

Recent releases. 4.2.0 added a --dry-run flag to every destructive subcommand after a long thread about how easy it was to delete the wrong environment. 4.1.0 rewrote the error messages so that each one names the file it is complaining about.

Contributing: open an issue before a large pull request. The maintainers are in Austin and reply on weekdays.

On 27 May 2025 the maintainers published a migration guide for the 4.0 release and froze the 3.x branch to security fixes only.
